_meta.scale: Forever. All weights are in units of the spec primary stat (1.00 = one point of it).
_meta.formula: score = ( SUM(forever_stats(item) * weight) + dps * dpsWeight + procPoints ) * armorClass[itemArmourType]. forever_stats folds spellHit/spellCrit/spellHaste/hitRanged/critRanged into hit/crit/haste, zeros armorPen/resilience, and sets sp_from_heal = max(explicit, heal/3). Hit, crit, haste, dodge, parry, and expertise weights are per 1%. Spell hit, spell crit, and spell haste are the same hit, crit, and haste.
_meta.armorNote: Armour class is a per-spec MULTIPLIER on the final score, never a filter, so a big enough stat upgrade still wins. Holy paladin cloth is penalized: they solo in melee and wear mail, then plate, so a cloth piece appears only when its healing more than pays for the missing armor. See the armorClass table on each spec. This was documented long before it was implemented; until it was wired in, Hunter and Rogue tier 3 outranked Paladin tier 2.
_meta.noLevelScaling: There is NO rating-scale-by-level, and no hidden stamina, armor, or mana multiplier. An earlier version multiplied rating stats by 70/playerLevel. That left ratings overvalued below 60, and it stays dead. A later version multiplied sta/health/hp5 by 3 and armor, intellect, spirit, mp5, and mana by 2 through level 60. That also stays dead: the sheet number is the score at every level. weights_at_level() returns the weights.json row. scripts/ci/check_no_leveling_multipliers.py fails if a multiplier comes back.
_meta.jackpotNote: Random-enchant greens rank on the best suffix jackpot (top of the range, e.g. Superior of Agility +7), not the expected value across every suffix. suffixChance (~9.5%) tells the player the roll is slim; if that roll would be #1 it must appear as BiS #1.
_meta.procNote: Proc value is added in the same points currency by procs.py: damage -> dps -> x dpsWeight; stat buff -> stat x uptime x that stat's weight; mitigation -> effective HP -> x stamina weight / 10. Every scenario constant is named at the top of that file and is an estimate, not sim output.
_meta.level60Note: Forever scores every level from the model (GQ_NO_GUIDES=1). Classic Wowhead BiS guides are TBC/era and must not pin level 60.
_meta.hunterNote: There is no ranged attack power weight. A ranged attack power line is attack power. Hunter attack power is 0.45 at levels 1-9, 0.4 Beast Mastery, 0.38 Marksmanship, 0.34 Survival. 1 Str = 1 attack power. 1 Agi = 1 attack power on the bow, so BM/MM dpsWeightRanged is 14 (1 bow DPS = 14 attack power = 14 Agi) and melee dpsWeight is 0.05. Survival is melee: dpsWeight 10, dpsWeightRanged 6, Strength 0.7. Marksmanship Int 0.40 assumes Careful Aim. Lone Wolf vs pet is one weight row (pet/BM default).
_meta.druidNote: Forever cat and bear use the equipped weapon's DPS. 14 attack power is 1 weapon DPS. Cat prices 1 attack power at 0.35 (half of strength 0.7), so dpsWeight is 4.9. Bear attack power stays 0.18 (half of strength 0.35), but bear dpsWeight is also 4.9: the form's white hit is the weapon's DPS in both forms, and 14 times 0.18 let a 20 DPS caster staff beat Heavehammer. feralAp stays equal to ap because in form it is plain attack power. Balance and Restoration never swing. levelling_1_9 keeps dpsWeight 2.0, because Bear form is not learned until 10. The Fang stun stays priced at 14, not at the cat dpsWeight. Leather and cloth only -- no mail, plate or shields -- and Staff/Mace/Dagger/Fist/Polearm only: no swords, no axes, no ranged weapon. The Ranged slot holds an Idol.
_meta.roleNote: Forever unifies hit, crit and haste across melee, ranged and spells. Those three are legal on every spec. Melee specs score expertise per 1%. Casters keep expertise at 0. armorPen/resilience/wpnSkill stay dead. Pure casters still have no str/ap/rap; pure physical specs still have no sp/heal except Ret, Enhance, and Paladin Protection. Warrior Protection is a physical tank -- spell damage does not rank BiS (defense on a caster piece is a notable). check_roles.py enforces this.
_meta.shamanNote: Forever Enhancement cannot dual wield and can equip 2H without a talent. Mental Dexterity is 1 AP per intellect. Enhancement int is 0.75 and agility 0.6 (Nov 2026 retune). Intellect is that sheet number at every level. Do not double it. Mental Quickness (30% Int->SP) and Maelstrom keep a smaller spell-power weight. Elemental and Restoration never hold an off-hand weapon. They keep staves and other legal two-handers beside the one-hander and shield. Axe/Mace/Staff/Dagger/Fist only. Ranged slot is a Totem. Enhancement Tank is a separate row and stays stamina-first.
_meta.rogueNote: Rogue is the hunter mirrored: dpsWeightRanged 0.0 because a rogue never fires the bow -- it is a stat stick -- while melee dpsWeight is 15.0 (1 Agi = 1 AP = 1/14 white dps plus crit ~= 0.095; 1 weapon dps = 1.0 x ~1.5 for Sinister Strike, Backstab and Eviscerate riding on weapon damage). Rogues get 1 AP per Strength, not 2. hit 9.5-10 is the highest physical hit weight in the project: the dual-wield miss penalty punishes being under the cap harder than for anyone else. Assassination wears daggers in both hands, because Ambush, Backstab, and Mutilate require them. Combat and Subtlety score every one-hand type a rogue can equip. The Weapons menu is where a player turns a type off for one hand. Combat still scores the axe highly. Leather and cloth only; no shields; no two-handers.
_meta.foreverNote: Weapon skill still exists on the Skills tab but item/racial skill sticks are gone or tiny -- wpnSkill weight is 0. Character sheet has no Hit or Expertise row; Hit on items still scores. Haste is a real % (about 1% baseline on melee sheets).

levelling_1_9.label: Levels 1-9 (no talents yet - shared by all three specs)

PALADIN._dpsWeightNote: Retribution 4.31 and levelling 4.31 are derived from mechanics: 1 Strength = 2 AP = 0.232 dps for a paladin, so 1 weapon dps = 1/0.232 = 4.31 Strength. Holy 0.086 follows the same ratio off its near-zero Strength weight. Protection is the exception: the same derivation gave 2.37, which put pure-DPS Naxxramas one-hand swords (The Hungering Cold, Gressil, Andonisus) at the top of the tank weapon list. A tank's threat comes overwhelmingly from Holy damage -- Seal and Judgement of Righteousness, Consecration, Holy Shield -- which scales off spell power and attack power, not weapon dps, so the ratio does not transfer. Swept 0.0 to 2.37 against Wowhead's Classic Naxxramas tank BiS guide; 0.0 and 0.5 tie for best agreement and 0.5 is chosen as the physically non-zero end of that tie.
PALADIN._weightProvenance: Ordinal priorities taken from Icy Veins TBC Classic stat-priority pages for each spec, then adapted for LEVELLING rather than raiding. That adaptation matters: the published priorities are for level-70 raiding, where hit-to-9%-cap, expertise and armour penetration dominate. Levelling gear from 1-69 carries almost none of those stats and the caps are irrelevant, so raw Strength, weapon damage and survivability stay ahead of them here. These are ordinal-derived, NOT sim-derived, and are the part of this model most worth Henrik's judgement -- editable live in the review page.
PALADIN._holyNote: Holy levels in melee. The weight row is what is scored, with no level multiplier. heal 1.3, sp 1, spHoly 1, int 0.85, spi 0.3, mp5 1.1, mana 0.04, crit 0.8, sta 0.3, armor 0.004. A v0.3.6 note that said heal/sp/spHoly 1.8, int 1.2, spi 1.5, and armor 0.15 was never applied. Do not retune the row to match it. +Holy Spell Damage is spHoly at 1, the same as generic spell power. Cloth armorClass 0.62, leather 0.82, mail 0.96, plate 1.0. Protection armor is 0.2. armorClass plate 1.0, mail 0.55, leather 0.35, cloth 0.18. Protection sp is 0.85, spHoly is 0.85, and mp5 is 0.2. Ranged attack power is 0 on every paladin spec. Do not copy the Holy equality rule onto Protection.
PALADIN._shockadinNote: Shockadin is spell Retribution, not a healer and not a talent tab. Spell power is the main stat at 1.0, then holy spell power 0.85, then intellect 0.4, then crit 0.55. Those sheet numbers are the score. Do not multiply them by level. Healing and sp_from_heal stay 0 so a healing line is not spell power; the damage half of an Equip line still folds into spell power. Strength 0.2 and attack power 0.1 keep a weapon swing without beating spell power. Weapon dpsWeight is 0.4, the same idea as a caster who swings, not Retribution's 4.31. Stamina 0.15, armor 0.004, spirit 0.1, mana per 5 0.2, mana 0.03. armorClass matches Holy: plate 1.0, mail 0.96, leather 0.82, cloth 0.62. Both weapon styles start on, one-hand plus shield or a two-hander. Do not copy the Holy spHoly-equals-healing rule onto this row.

WARRIOR._note: Warrior. Arms is two-hand, Fury dual-wields one-handers, Protection is one-hand plus shield. Unlike Paladin there is a real Ranged slot (bows, guns, crossbows, thrown) instead of a relic. Rage, not mana: int, spirit, mp5 and mana are 0 on every warrior spec, same as rogue. A green of the Eagle is not a warrior hunt.
